ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.Bypass_Color_Review_Gates) && ISCHANGED(Color_Review_Stage__c) && CASE(TEXT(Color_Review_Stage__c), "Red Review", IF(ISBLANK(Pink_Completed_Date__c) && NOT(Pink_Skipped__c), 1, 0), "Blue Review", IF(ISBLANK(Red_Completed_Date__c) || (Total_Requirements__c > 0 && Addressed_Requirements__c < Total_Requirements__c), 1, 0), "Gold Review", IF(ISBLANK(Blue_Completed_Date__c), 1, 0), "Green Review", IF(ISBLANK(Gold_Completed_Date__c), 1, 0), "Complete", IF(ISBLANK(Green_Completed_Date__c), 1, 0), 0) = 1
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Reviews must be completed in order. The previous color needs a Completed Date (it is stamped automatically once its required sign-offs and deliverables are in), and Blue cannot open until every RFP Requirement is Validated or has a documented exception.
